description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM and a baseline Vanilla model. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio as a percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. The plot includes five lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, star marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, dash marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, square marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, triangle marker, solid line), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, circle marker, solid line). The Vanilla line remains steady at 100% across the x-axis. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at around 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to 100% at 3e8 TFLOPs before slightly decreasing to around 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at approximately 96.8% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to 99.9% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then fluctuates between 99.5% and 99.9% until 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at about 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs, reaches 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then remains around 99.8% to 100% until 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line begins at around 94.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to 98.7% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then decreases to approximately 98.5% at 9e8 TFLOPs, with some fluctuations in between.
